register_custom_op: register a python function as a custom torch operator with optional in-place mutation tracking
register_custom_op_from_extern: wrap an external library function as a custom op for torch.compile compatibility
create_custom_op_inplace: create a custom torch operator that mutates arguments in-place using mutates_args parameter
build_custom_op_with_output: build a custom torch operator with out_shape to auto-generate a fake implementation for torch.compile
wrap_external_op_computed_args: wrap an external function as a custom op with computed_args to exclude dynamic arguments from the schema
